boundaries: This is an exact counterexample to an unchanged regular-scheme extension, not a classification of non-Desarguesian spreads.
The Ree--Tits and Ball--Zieve coordinate constructions retain literature ownership.
The observed congruence of all intersection values modulo 9 is recorded only as a future question.
theorem: The regular-spread {1,q+1} intersection scheme does not extend unchanged to the q=27 Ree--Tits symplectic spread: an exact closed 144-spread suborbit already exhibits intersections 19,28,37,46,55.
